traits.name: Mask of Personas
traits.description: The letterhead wears a mask blessed by Hightrankul. So long as one of Hightrankul’s followers wears it, their voice and mannerisms cannot be discerned by those studying them, and their voice is not recognizable as their own.

actions.name: Cursed Ink Dagger
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +4 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 5 (1d4 + 2) piercing damage plus 5 (2d4) psychic damage. If any of the damage dice from this attack rolls a result of 1, the target must make a DC 13 Charisma saving throw. On a failure, they suffer points of Combat Fatigue equal to the number of 1s rolled as part of this attack’s damage. If all three damage dice return a result of 1, they suffer a level of exhaustion on a failure instead.

actions.name: Stamp of Names
actions.description: The letterhead takes out a bewitched black page folded into an envelope, which burns in their hand. The cultist chooses one creature it can see, and makes a commanding request of them in the form of a short phrase, producing the effects of the command spell with a save DC of 14. If the letterhead knows the full name of their target or of any crimes they have committed, the target has disadvantage on their saving throw. The target is the only creature who hears the commanding request given, or any utterance of their name or crimes.
